user.title: PalPulse for Home Assistant
user.description: Enter the Powerpal BLE MAC address. The ESPHome node must emit PalPulse timestamped record events.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid six-byte MAC address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

abort.already_configured: This Powerpal meter is already configured.

flat.title: Flat electricity tariff
flat.description: Enter your actual electricity rate and optional daily supply fee in cents. Confirm rates against your bill.

time_of_use.title: Time of use / free power
time_of_use.description: Enter your actual peak, shoulder, off-peak and optional free electricity windows. Times follow Home Assistant's local timezone. For Red Power5, verify your free hours and daily allowance against your bill.

data_description.daily_free_cap_kwh: For Red Power5, enter 15; for Red Midday Power Saver, 24
data_description.free_excess_cents_per_kwh: Red Power5 previously used 16.412 c/kWh in your local configuration. Verify current bill before use.

pricing.title: Electricity pricing
pricing.description: Use Home Assistant's own pricing (default), or configure Australian flat and time-of-use tariffs in PalPulse.

historical_costs.title: Historical daily cost import
historical_costs.description: Set up a separate, opt-in import of your previous electricity costs. Choose a cumulative cost statistic or a daily-reset cost sensor with genuine hourly closing states. Preview first. Import requires a verified Home Assistant backup and an existing PalPulse live cost baseline.

data_description.legacy_cost_statistic_id: For example, sensor.electricity_cost_today. Check that this source has recorded hourly cost states or cumulative sums. A $/kWh price sensor cannot be imported.
data_description.legacy_cost_source_mode: Choose daily-reset only if the recorded cost resets to zero each local day. Incomplete or ambiguous days are skipped.

error.invalid_pricing: Invalid rate, free allowance or tariff window. Check for overlapping peak/shoulder periods.
error.invalid_source: Choose a valid sensor.* or external statistic ID different from the PalPulse cost statistic, or leave it blank.
error.migration_locked: Undo the previous cost migration before changing its source or source type. Existing history was left untouched.
